paragraphs.text: Gilberto Tinoco Arzate participated in Shipment LZC-10-04 on 2010-04-25. Bruma del Cobre was linked to Shipment LZC-10-04 on 2010-04-25. Shipment LZC-10-04 occurred at Lázaro Cárdenas on 2010-04-25. A bank compliance officer cooperating with the reporting office identified a payment pattern consistent with a 35 kg load of methamphetamine precursor leaving Lázaro Cárdenas for Los Angeles under the direction of Tinoco, the network's port logistics figure. The officer's information comes from transaction records rather than from direct observation of the load.

Gilberto Tinoco Arzate used DEMO-ACCT-00130 on 2010-04-25. Shipment LZC-10-04 transited Lázaro Cárdenas port plaza on 2010-04-25. Bruma del Cobre controlled Lázaro Cárdenas port plaza from 2010-03-14 until 2012-07-09. The officer stated that the account identified above received a deposit on the day of the shipment and that the deposit was followed by cash withdrawals in Lázaro Cárdenas. The officer characterized the pattern as consistent with payments to dock staff. The officer understood from the account history that the network had controlled the Lázaro Cárdenas docks since the spring.

Rogelio Anzures Tapia led Bruma del Cobre from 2010-03-14 until 2014-08-02. The officer identified Anzures as the beneficial owner behind several related accounts. The reporting office assesses the officer as reliable on financial records and notes that the quantity of the load is inferred from payment size rather than observed. The reporting office requests that any related seizure data be shared with the originating desk. The officer noted that the deposits into the account were structured in amounts below the bank's reporting threshold and that the originating accounts were held by two trucking firms in Colima. The officer has retained the transaction records and will provide them to the reporting office through the standard liaison channel.
